propositions: Under rich_text_cutover=cloud, the outbound comment differ computes its body-equality dedup key with different decoders on local and Jira sides, causing markdown comments to never match their own landed body.

The local dedup key applies a markdown round-trip normalize_outbound which escapes markdown-active characters, while the Jira-side key applies adf_to_text which does not escape, producing divergent keys for identical bodies.

The send path encodes a decorated body and markdown_to_adf's content-preservation fallback degrades it to plain text, but the local key derives from the undecorated body's rich round-trip, compounding the asymmetry.

The fix derives the local dedup key by predicting the exact as-sent wire (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it with the same decoder as the Jira side, unifying both keys under one decode composition.
Test coverage validates that in-limit markdown bodies under cloud cutover no longer emit duplicate mutations and that genuinely new markdown comments are still correctly emitted.
